page.notes: The "ꝟ" sign before the verse numbers is a V with a stroke, read as the usual abbreviation for "Ver." (verse); marked as doubtful. Roman numerals are spaced in the print ("XXXV I.", "X X X VII.", "XXXV II."); copied as printed, likely typesetting gaps. "Addenda ed" is printed as such (likely for "ad").
